title: Holistic Explainable AI (H-XAI): Extending Transparency Beyond Developers in AI-Driven Decision Making

bias_targets.methodology: Applying causal Rating-Driven Explanation (RDE) metrics, specifically the Average Treatment Effect (ATE), to quantify how altering an applicant's age impacts their predicted creditworthiness in a credit risk classification model.

Using causal metrics (such as Deconfounded Impact Estimation and Average Treatment Effect) alongside post-hoc XAI tools like SHAP to evaluate differences in credit risk model outcomes between male and female applicants.

Utilizing statistical and causal evaluation metrics (such as ATE and Weighted Rejection Score) to test for systematic disparities in loan approval predictions based on an applicant's marital or personal status.

Measuring disparities in time-series forecasting model performance by treating 'Company' as a protected attribute and comparing residual errors across different companies using the Weighted Rejection Score (WRS) under various input perturbations.
